explicit_implementation_choices: Public geographic input/output uses degrees, core trigonometric calculations use radians
Projected E is east, N is north; longitude normalized about the central meridian
Default ellipsoid is the exact thesis a,b rather than silently replacing b by WGS84
Planning uses standard axes inverse; thesis eq3.8 literal swapped-axis version remains audit-only
General true-scale latitude uses standard cos-squared denominator; paper B0=0 makes the observed printed difference vanish
Cell size is metres per cell; world-to-grid divides by dx/dy and explicitly chooses north-up or south-down rows
Grid coordinate origin is a cell corner, cell_center adds one half, cell_index uses half-open cells
unresolved_author_alignment: Whether the author code uses the axis convention printed in eq3.7 or eq3.8
Whether dx/dy in the author implementation denote metres per cell or reciprocal scale
Whether the cos term lacking a squared exponent is only a printed equation issue; B0=0 in the actual stated setup is unaffected
